_comment: Alphabetic prefixes of identifier FAMILIES that are standardised identifiers, never course codes, in any discipline or institution: book numbers, cryptographic hash names, digital object identifiers, programme-specific-outcome/educational-objective labels. Used by the curriculum parser to refuse treating e.g. 'ISBN13: 9781259676512' or 'SHA-256' as a course header. Deliberately EXCLUDES short prefixes such as 'CO' or 'PO' that some institutions legitimately use as course-code prefixes; outcome labels like PO10 are instead rejected downstream by structural evidence (no semester placement, no repeated occurrence). Data, not code: extend by editing this file. 'TOTAL' is the label of a scheme table's aggregate rows ('TOTAL 16 - 8 - 630 420 20', 'GRAND TOTAL 24'), never a course: found as four fabricated courses that captured every topic of a real syllabus.
